name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology in Chemical Engineering
faculty: Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment
notes: Qual code BNCME1. CAO code DU-D-ECH. Campus: Steve Biko. No minimum APS stated. Technical Mathematics (Level 5) and Technical Sciences (Level 5) accepted; no separate APS. Mathematical Literacy not accepted. Also requires two recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 4. Ranked on the sum of Mathematics and Physical Sciences marks (minimum combined 100%). Technical Drawing and/or Computer Studies recommended. Alternative entry: NQF 6 Diploma in Engineering (credit transfer possible). Alternative entry for Bachelor-pass applicants missing the Maths/Science requirement: N4 Mathematics and Engineering Science plus Engineering Drawing and Chemical Engineering Fundamentals (50%, max two sittings). Duration not stated. Limited places.

name: Bachelor of Engineering Technology in Electronic Engineering
faculty: Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment
notes: Qual code BNELC1. CAO code DU-D-BGL. Campus: Steve Biko. Entry table is headed 'Electrical Engineering'. No minimum APS stated. Also requires two recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 4. Ranked on the sum of Mathematics and Physical Sciences marks (minimum combined 100%). Alternative entry for Bachelor-pass applicants missing the Maths/Science requirement: N4 Mathematics and Engineering Science plus any two of Industrial Electronics/Electronics, Digital/Logic Systems, Electrotechnics (50%, same sitting). Duration not stated. Limited places.

name: Bachelor of the Built Environment in Architecture
faculty: Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment
notes: Qual code BBARC1. CAO code DU-D-BAT. Campus: Steve Biko. No minimum APS stated. Mathematical Literacy not accepted; Technical Mathematics not listed. Also requires three recognised 20-credit subjects at Level 4. Recommended (not required): Technology, History, Art, Technical Drawing, Geography, Physics. Leads to registration as a candidate architectural technologist (SACAP). Limited places.
